title: <sup>18</sup>F-labeling of peptides using FBEM
protocol: Heat the oil bath in a well-ventilated, lead-shielding hood to a temperature of 40°C.
Weigh 1.0 mg N-(2-aminoethyl)maleimide.
Dissolve N-(2-aminoethyl)maleimide with 100 μl DMSO in a 5 ml mini-vial.
Add 20 μl DIPEA to the vial containing dissolved maleimide.
Cap the vial with a screw cap.
Equilibrate the HPLC column by rinsing it with 5% solution A and 95% solution B at 5 ml/min flow for 5 minutes.
Run the equilibrated HPLC column with 95% solution A and 5% solution B at 5 ml/min flow for another 5 minutes.
Weigh 200 μg SRGD2 with 50 μl DMSO in a microcentrifuge tube.
Weigh 1.0 mg TCEP·HCl.
Dissolve TCEP·HCl with 100 μl water in a 5-ml mini-vial.
Add the SRGD2 solution to the vial containing dissolved TCEP·HCl.
Pre-treat C18 Sep-Pak cartridge with 10 ml ethanol.
Pre-treat C18 Sep-Pak cartridge further with 10 ml water.
Transfer crude <sup>18</sup>F-SFB (100 mCi) in 2.0 ml acetonitrile to the round-bottom flask containing 20 ml water and 1 ml 5% acetic acid solution.
Pass <sup>18</sup>F-SFB solution through a pretreated C18 Sep-Pak cartridge.
Wash the C18 Sep-Pak cartridge with 5 ml water.
Wash the C18 Sep-Pak cartridge further with 2 ml acetonitrile and collect the eluent in a 50-ml pear-shaped flask.
Attach the flask to a micro rotary evaporator to remove the solvent.
Add another 1.5 ml acetonitrile and 0.5 ml DMSO to the flask.
Concentrate the solvent to less than 0.5 ml using the micro rotary evaporator.
Transfer 100-200 μl of <sup>18</sup>F-SFB solution to the mini-vial.
Add 1.0 mg N-(2-aminoethyl)maleimide and 100 μl DMSO to the mini-vial.
Incubate the solution at 40°C for 15 minutes.
Add 600 μl of 1.5% TFA water to the mini-vial.
Withdraw the solution into a 1-ml syringe with an HPLC needle.
Rinse the vial with 100 μl of 1.5% TFA and withdraw the rinse into the same syringe.
Inject the solution onto the HPLC.
Collect the HPLC fractions containing <sup>18</sup>F-FBEM (Rt = 13.8-14.2 min) in a test tube.
Transfer these fractions to a 50-ml pear-shaped flask.
Rinse the test tube with 500 μl of acetonitrile and transfer to the same flask.
Attach the flask to a micro rotary evaporator to concentrate to 100-200 μl.
Reconstruct <sup>18</sup>F-FBEM in 600 μl PBS and transfer to a 5-ml mini-vial with SRGD2 and TCEP·HCl solution.
Adjust the pH to 7.2 using 0.2 mol/l NaOH solution.
React for 20 minutes at room temperature (20°C).
Rinse the vial containing the reaction mixture with 100 μl 1% TFA water.
Withdraw the reaction mixture and rinsing solution into a 1-ml syringe.
Inject the solution onto the HPLC.
Collect HPLC fractions containing <sup>18</sup>F-FBEM (Rt=15.1-15.5 min) in a test tube.
Transfer these collected fractions to a 50-ml pear-shaped flask.
Rinse the test tube with 500 μl acetonitrile and transfer this solution to the same flask.
Attach the flask to a micro rotary evaporator to remove the solvent.
Reconstitute the remaining material with 200 μl PBS (1x, pH 7.4).
